items.text: – Hmm, bija dan fryserii. Jos bijat dan fryserii, de dasa ii dáhpáhuva mihkkege, vaikko jagi ge. Mii nu eará lea báhcán, bija dan maid fryserii.
items.q: A mother mentions the freezer. Is 'fryserii' the everyday word for a home freezer, correctly spelled and inflected here?
before: – Juo, mun borren daid, Nini-jan. Ale fuolastuva. Dušše veaháš lea báhcán Mahbouba ráhkadan lavashakas.

items.text: Sii rogget hávddiid hui čiekŋalin. Sii golgadedje eatnama su ala bulldoseriin.
items.q: A mother talks about a bulldozer. Is 'bulldoseriin' the usual word for it, correctly spelled and inflected here?
before: Doppe dolvot sin geat goddojuvvojit jápmenduomu mielde, ja doppe hávdádit maiddái koronas jápmán olbmuid. Ipmil okto diehtá, basse go sii su rituálalaččat vai eai. Mii geahččaimet guhkkin eret. Go sii bidje su hávdái, de hávdeliidni rahpasii oanehaččat. Munnje orui dego sii livčče giessan su hávdeliidnái seamma biktasiiguin mat sus ledje go mii dolvuimet su buohcciviessui.
